notes: v586 — ONE RULER. Until today the 💧 floor changed TWO things at once: which shares you saw AND which universe every line's report card was measured on — which is why a LOWER floor could show FEWER badges (micro-caps joining the averages dragged proven edges under the costs bar). That coupling is gone. Every line is now measured ONCE per day, on the $250k universe — shares you could actually trade. Your 💧 floor only filters which shares you are viewing: lower always shows more, never fewer, and changing it can never change a badge. Shares trading below $250k a day wear their badge dimmed with a 💧 mark — the edge is borrowed from bigger shares, not earned on theirs. One ruler also means one shared daily grade for every device at every floor — faster for everyone. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
